details: This package is a placeholder stub published under a scope that copies the name of the legitimate @whiskeysockets/baileys WhatsApp library, with no affiliation to that project. The published tarball contains exactly two files and no executable code: package/package.json (154 bytes) and package/README.md (190 bytes), 344 bytes unpacked in total. The manifest declares "stub": true, description "Temporary package placeholder for staged publishing", with no scripts, no bin entries, no dependencies and no optional dependencies. The README states it is a "Temporary Holding Version" and that "an operational version to replace this has been submitted for review and is awaiting a staged release" — a name-reservation pattern that holds a brand-impersonating package name ahead of an executable release. Earlier versions published under this same package name did carry malicious code, so the name should be treated as hostile and the follow-up release watched. This specific version has no network indicators, drops no files and executes nothing.
